content.Title: 2020 ACC/AHA Guideline for the Management of Valvular Heart Disease

Subsections.Title: 7.3.1. Stages of Chronic Secondary MR
Subsections.Content: This section discusses the discordance between echocardiography and MR in the assessment of mitral regurgitation severity, with references to studies like the one by Uretsky et al. and Grayburn et al.

Subsections.Title: 7.3.2. Diagnosis of Chronic Secondary MR
Subsections.Content: Diagnostic guidelines recommend cardiac magnetic resonance for evaluating regurgitation severity. References to Grigioni et al. and Cameli et al. are provided.

Subsections.Title: 7.3.3. Medical Therapy
Subsections.Content: The guideline discusses the efficacy of medications such as enalapril in chronic heart failure, citing studies like SOLVD and others.

Subsections.Title: 7.3.4. Intervention
Subsections.Content: This includes guidelines on surgical or percutaneous interventions such as trans-catheter valve repair for mitral regurgitation. Studies by Stone et al. and Obadia et al. are referenced.
